question: Does the bounded native massless flat matter/radiation/Lambda control agree with independent reference calculations on exact ordered DESI DR2 Gaussian BAO compression?
assumptions: Chosen H0 and density fractions are parameter controls, not new observations or a fitted posterior.
Flat pressureless matter, massless radiation and Lambda; baryons subset matter, photons subset radiation. Supplied drag origin.
Released full ordered 13-axis Gaussian ratio compression treated conditionally under its release assumptions.
limitations: Full Planck2018 six-parameter massive-neutrino/thermal-drag/CMB model is blocked.
No fit, posterior, raw catalog reconstruction or joint SN/BAO independence claim.
Golden dataset means exact versioned bytes and axis checks, not cosmological truth.

inputs.semantics: DESI DR2 released fitted distance-ratio compression; dimensionless ratios/full ratio-squared covariance in exact 13-row mean order. Retain release selection/reconstruction/calibration assumptions; unknown cross-probe overlap is not independence. Not raw galaxy data.
